items.comments: Well organized booking and arrival processes.  Apartment was as described and expected.  Well equipped, good location, and good building amenities.  Apartment is comfortable for 2 people.  Any more than 2 requires use of the sofa sleeper, which proves to be, as with most sofa sleeper beds... uncomfortable.  Other than that, a great stay.  Thanks.
The condo was exactly as described and the host was very flexible with check-in time; everything was easy peasy.  Our needs were anticipated and there were no issues with the rental.
Everyone was most helpful, including a late arrival by us and getting the key. All much appreciated and made our stay in Seattle wonderful. Great location, clean and tidy
